title: Very long lines
hints: bufio.Scanner refuses lines longer than 64 KiB. When that happens Scan returns false, and only sc.Err() tells you why.
Always check sc.Err() after the loop. That alone turns the silent wrong answer into an error.
To accept longer lines, give the scanner a bigger limit before the first Scan: sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), 1<<20).
